meta.frame: plan frame of plan.json (metres, x along a..J, y along 1..10, +y street side)
meta.furniture: centre [x,y]; size [width across heading, depth along heading]; heading = degrees of atan2(dy,dx) of the direction the piece faces (bed: head->foot; sofa/WC/basin/TV/worktop: away from the wall it backs onto; chair: towards its table); heading_free = symmetric or free-standing, heading arbitrary
meta.rooms: area = the room's share of the flat fill (walls split down the middle; sums to the flat); area_net = free floor; polygon / polygon_net likewise; label = pole of inaccessibility; stance.eye z 1.6 above the level floor
meta.corner_glyphs: bath_corner (>= 1.2 m) and shower_corner (0.8 - 1.0 m) are the same quarter-round glyph drawn at different sizes
meta.kitchens: the sheets draw kitchens as a worktop front line only (no sink/hob/fridge symbols); kitchen_run = one straight leg of the worktop, worktop = its polygon
meta.aspect: -y north, +y south (street), -x west, +x east; courtyard = over the podium terrace (bar south face west of the wing, wing west face)
